dev.mstream.autoup_off_warn: Manual mode — srtla_send will not see this path until you add it by hand.
dev.mstream.help_relay: Relays discover themselves over UDP and announce their shared interfaces. Each announced interface becomes a tunnel here — there is no relay endpoint to enter.
dev.mstream.help_tun: Each relay interface gets its own TUN (relayX_<iface>) whose IP is derived from the relay index and interface order: 10.90.0.1, 10.90.1.1, …
dev.mstream.status_idle: Idle — enable and start (relays are discovered automatically)
